units.source_text: 所有这一切统统没有必要坦白出来。

en.t: There was no need to confess any of this at all.

units.source_text: 我只不过是受命于人，被迫为之而已。

en.t: I had merely been ordered by someone else and forced to do it.

units.source_text: 假使反抗的话，我自己也不知道会遭到什么灾难呢。

en.t: If I resisted, I myself had no idea what kind of disaster might befall me.
